note: Tutorial summary page 3: Suspend Save, soft reset, Quick Continue

blocks.text: ● The {o|"Suspend Save"} general command saves your progress on the map.
● Choosing {o|"CONTINUE"} on the title screen returns you to the state saved with {o|"Suspend Save"}.

● Press {i:combo} at the same time to soft reset. If you keep holding {i:start}, the title screen is skipped and the title's {o|"CONTINUE"} command runs automatically. This is called {o|Quick Continue}.
